page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraving (St Andrew's cross scene with a naked bearded man on an X-shaped cross, landscape with castles, trees and hills) with a library stamp in blue at the lower right. No text block.
page.notes: Engraving of a martyr figure tied to an X-shaped (saltire) cross, with a town and castle landscape behind. No printed text in the engraving. Blue oval library stamp at lower right (partly legible: "BIBLIOTECA ... NAVEL..."), which is a library stamp and therefore not transcribed. Fragmentary marginal letters at the extreme left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
